title: Decoding Sequence-Structure-Function-Evolution of basic Leucine Zippers of Aureochromes from Heterokont Algae
authors: Khamaru M; Bose D; Deb A; Mitra D
one_liner_zh: 该文综合序列/结构生物信息学、网络分析与分子动力学模拟，系统研究异鞭毛藻Aureochrome转录因子bZIP结构域与DNA的互作机制，并揭示独特组氨酸残基对DNA结合的关键作用，高度契合TF-DNA结合与互作机制建模课题。
abstract:
The blue light photoreceptor cum transcription factors, Aureochromes (Aureos), are present exclusively in photosynthetic stramenopiles. Co-existence of Light-Oxygen-Voltage (LOV) and basic leucine zipper (bZIP) is unique to Aureos – therefore ideal to study light-dependent DNA binding/transcriptional regulation. Further, Aureos’ inverse effector-sensor topology, resembling several sensory eukaryotic transcription factors, makes them prototypical optogenetic scaffolds. In absence of 3D data, this study aims for a thorough investigation of the bZIP domains from Aureos and others, and their interaction with substrate DNA using tools from sequence/structural bioinformatics, network theory, molecular dynamics simulation and in vitro experiments. An in-depth comparison of 173 Aureo/plant/opisthokont bZIPs reveals Aureos’ uniqueness and evolutionary significance in DNA binding specificity as well as dimer stability. An all-atom network analysis on representative bZIP-DNA co-crystal structures, especially the measurement of eigenvector centrality, further adds importance to hydrophobic interactions in the zipper region to stabilize bZIP dimer and facilitate DNA binding in Aureos and other bZIPs. Perhaps the most notable finding is the unique histidine substitution at the basic region of Aureos unlike any other bZIPs. Not only is this residue important for DNA binding, this can serve as a potential switch point in Aureo/bZIP evolution.

Highlights

Aureochrome is perhaps the only light-responsive transcription factor in bZIP superfamily. We draw a comparative between aureochromes and other bZIPs via in-silico / in-vitro methods. Aureochromes form a distinctly separate lineage, midway in bZIP evolution. The unique histidine facilitates aureochromes’ interaction with cognate DNA substrates.
abstract_zh:
蓝光光感受器兼转录因子——金色素蛋白（Aureochromes, Aureos）——仅存在于光合作用的不等鞭毛生物中。光-氧-电压（Light-Oxygen-Voltage, LOV）结构域与碱性亮氨酸拉链（basic leucine zipper, bZIP）结构域的共存是Aureos独有的特性，因此成为研究光依赖性DNA结合/转录调控的理想模型。此外，Aureos的效应器-传感器反向拓扑结构类似于多种感觉性真核转录因子，使其成为典型的光遗传学支架。在缺乏三维数据的情况下，本研究旨在通过序列/结构生物信息学、网络理论、分子动力学模拟及体外实验等手段，对Aureos及其他bZIP结构域及其与底物DNA的相互作用进行深入探究。对173个Aureo/植物/后生动物bZIP的深度比较揭示了Aureos在DNA结合特异性及二聚体稳定性方面的独特性和进化意义。对代表性bZIP-DNA共晶结构的全原子网络分析，特别是特征向量中心性的测量，进一步强调了拉链区域疏水相互作用在稳定bZIP二聚体及促进Aureos和其他bZIP DNA结合中的重要性。或许最显著的发现是Aureos碱性区域中独特的组氨酸替代，这在其他bZIP中未见。该残基不仅对DNA结合至关重要，还可能作为Aureo/bZIP进化中的潜在开关点。

亮点

Aureochrome可能是bZIP超家族中唯一的光响应转录因子。我们通过计算机模拟/体外方法对金色素蛋白与其他bZIP进行了比较。Aureochromes形成一条明显独立的谱系，位于bZIP进化中间位置。独特的组氨酸促进了金色素蛋白与同源DNA底物的相互作用。
